paragraph: The government inaugurated its [National Data Centre and Cloud at Camama on 28 April 2026](<https://www.menosfios.com/data-centers-em-angola-quais-tem-certificacao-internacional/>). Infosi, the state's IT institute, runs it. In the last twelve months, [Menos Fios reported in May 2026 that its modules are certified Tier III](<https://www.menosfios.com/data-centers-em-angola-quais-tem-certificacao-internacional/>). The building awaits the Uptime Institute's assessment. In April 2026 the telecoms ministry said [the state-owned centre hosts data in the national territory](<https://www.verangola.net/va/en/042026/Technology/48622/New-government-data-center-reinforces-the-country's-digital-sovereignty.htm>). No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III has been found. Operating would need two or more such centres at Tier III or above.

As at 30 September 2026, [the World Bank reports that Burundi Backbone System (BBS) has one level-3 data center](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/605991608528899689/pdf/Burundi-Digital-Economy-Assessment.pdf>), built at a cost of USD 2 million. BBS uses it to offer hosting to customers, and other public agencies use it to back up their systems. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one nationally owned data centre for hire to be Tier III or above.

In April 2026 [an ASIN official said Benin has several data centres](<https://cio-mag.com/souverainete-et-cloud-le-benin-face-aux-enjeux-de-lhebergement-des-donnees/>). One of them is run commercially by SBIN, the Société béninoise des infrastructures numériques. In the last twelve months, La Marina BJ reported in August 2026 that [the state data centre hosts ministries' applications](<https://lamarina.bj/2026/08/24/souverainete-tech-comment-la-sbin-sest-fait-evincer-dun-contrat-cle-de-lasin/>). ASIN, the state's digital agency, manages it. [MTN Bénin rents servers and storage to businesses](<https://www.mtn.bj/business/connectivite/data-center/>). No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one such centre at Tier III or above.

As at 12 November 2026, [BTW Media describes VTS's Virtix data centre in Ouagadougou as Tier III](<https://btw.media/it-infrastructure/virtual-technologies-solutions-burkina-faso-connectivity-provider/>). It is in service and offers colocation, and no certifying body is named. In the last twelve months, on 11 November 2026, [President Traoré said the data of the new unique identifier is hosted in Burkinabè data centres](<https://www.sidwaya.info/2026/11/11/operation-denregistrement-de-masse-de-lidentifiant-unique-le-capitaine-ibrahim-traore-lance-loperation-denrolement/>) run by public bodies. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more such centres at Tier III or above.

In April 2026 [BoFiNet's chief executive said the Digital Delta Data Centre is Uptime Institute Tier III certified and serves government, state companies and private firms](<https://businessweekly.co.bw/news/bofinet-pushes-for-local-data-hosting-to-strengthen-security>). [Mmegi reports that critical Botswana government services have migrated to the Digital Delta Data Centre](<https://www.mmegi.bw/business/digital-delta-data-centre-to-improve-public-service-delivery/news>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

In July 2026 Digital Mag said [the VITIB public data centre rents colocation space to public bodies and approved companies](<https://digitalmag.ci/stockage-de-donnees-les-10-datacenters-en-cote-divoire-pour-un-debut-de-souverainete-numerique/>). In the last twelve months, the health directorate said in July 2026 that [the records of over 2 million patients are hosted only in the state's national datacenter](<https://disd.ci/forum-club-sante-2026-la-disd-fixe-le-cap-de-lintelligence-artificielle-en-cote-divoire/>), which it calls Tier III. That centre is not said to rent space to others. No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one nationally owned data centre for hire to be Tier III or above.

In June 2026 Camtel said [its Zamengoé data centre near Yaoundé is certified Tier III by the Uptime Institute](<https://ecobiz54.info/telecoms-camtel-devoile-le-data-center-de-zamengoe-prouesse-de-souverainete-numerique-et-de-protection-des-donnees-au-cameroun/>). More than a hundred public and private bodies host their data there. [ST DIGITAL says its data centres, including those in Cameroon, are built to Tier 3 and TIA-942](<https://st.digital/en/blog/st-digital-s-blog-1/st-digital-526>), and names no Cameroonian site. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [Ministries and state administrations host data there](<https://newsupfront.com/digital-sovereignty-public-applauds-strides-of-camtels-zamengoue-data-center-at-sago-2026/>), and in June 2026 Camtel called Zamengoé [a critical national asset for the local control of government data](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/5885/camtel-highlights-digital-sovereignty-and-data-protection-at-government-action-fair-in-yaounde>).

No stage is set. In the last twelve months, the finance minister said in July 2026 that [the ministry's own data centre, in Kinshasa and Lubumbashi, hosts its digital projects](<https://www.deskeco.com/2026/07/15/rdc-un-centre-de-donnees-du-ministere-de-finances-cree-kinshasa-et-lubumbashi-en-vue-daccelerer-la>). No source has been found that says a data centre for hire in the country is nationally owned. None dated in the last three years says there is none. Preparing would need a data centre owned by the state, a state enterprise or a company owned in the country to rent space, power or computing to others.

On 28 February 2024 the regulator ARPCE [put its Pointe-Noire data centre into service](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/congo-s-e-denis-sassou-nguesso-connecte-le-pays-au-cable-2-africa-le-datacenter-tier-3-de-larpce-inaugure/>). ARPCE calls it Tier 3+ on its own word, naming no certification. The government portal [calls it the State's second, after one built in Brazzaville in 2021](<https://gouvernement.cg/economie-numerique-denis-sassou-nguesso-connecte-le-congo-au-cable-2africa/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No Tier has been found for the Brazzaville centre, and no second Tier III centre has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

As at 30 September 2026, [Comores Câbles states that its data centre offers secure, scalable data-management and hosting solutions to businesses of all sizes](<https://www.comorescables.km/Technologies>). [The Data Center of the Public Administration is co-managed by state agency ANADEN and Comores Câbles](<http://web.archive.org/web/20260824175002/https://dig.watch/countries/comoros>) and hosts critical services. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one nationally owned data centre for hire to be Tier III or above.

[NOSi's 2024 accounts state the Praia data centre holds Uptime Institute Tier III certification](<https://nosi.cv/documents/20121/3100977/Relat%C3%B3rio%20e%20Contas%20NOSi%20-%202024.pdf/2fe4a66a-1826-4951-4da3-9cce82aef26e>). On 16 February 2026 [NOSi, a public enterprise, launched a solar power system for its Praia data centre](<https://nosi.cv/pt/web/guest/w/lan%C3%A7amento-do-sistema-de-energia-fotovoltaico-do-data-center-da-praia>). No change in its certification has been found in the last twelve months. [Huawei's case study says NOSi's national data center hosts the eGovernment cloud](<https://e.huawei.com/at/case-studies/global/2018/201807051343>). No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

As at 18 October 2026, [Djibouti Telecom's own page describes a Tier-3 data centre (DDC) with colocation](<https://international.djiboutitelecom.dj/>). The page's header gives the tier as the operator's statement, not a certification. [Djibouti Telecom's own overview presents the Ras Dika cable landing station and data centre in Djibouti City](<https://international.djiboutitelecom.dj/>), a three-floor building with a colocation centre on the third floor. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

On 5 July 2026 [President Tebboune opened the Mohammadia complex of the Centre national des services numériques](<https://www.jeune-independant.net/centre-national-des-services-numeriques-lalgerie-scelle-le-virage-vers-leconomie-2-0/>), which holds Uptime Institute Tier III Design certification. In July 2026 [the centre said it hosts public institutions' data in virtual data centres](<https://elmassar-elarabi.dz/152310>) at Mohammadia and Blida. In the last twelve months, in November 2026, [the High Commission for Digitalisation said the centre's two sites, at Mohammadia and Blida, are both certified Tier III](<https://www.jeune-independant.net/transformation-numerique-le-hcn-renforce-son-dispositif-daccompagnement/>). They run active-active.

In August 2026 Fintech Gate said [the hub's RDH1, in service since 2021, holds several Tier III certificates](<https://www.fintechgate.net/250173>), and [the hub sells colocation as a carrier-neutral site](<https://ir.te.eg/en/CorporateNews/PressRelease/227/Telecom-Egypt-Grants-Preliminary-Approval-to-Helios-Investment-s-Binding-Offer-for-Partnership-in-Regional-Data-Hub-to-Expand-Business>). [The state's main data centre opened on 28 April 2024](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/7296670>), with a closed government cloud for 114 government bodies. No change has been found in the last twelve months. In April 2026 [the New Capital centre's director said government bodies take their services from the main data centre](<https://en.al-khaber.com/egypts-premier-inspects-new-capital-command-centre-managing-middle-easts-largest-state-tech-infrastructure/>).

As at 30 September 2026, [Eritel Telecom Corporation's own service page offers paid Eritel Nextcloud private-cloud subscriptions](<https://eritel.com.er/contents.php?id=1046>), which it says are completely hosted in Eritel's Datacenters. An operator data centre in Eritrea is therefore selling hosting to outside customers. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one nationally owned data centre for hire to be Tier III or above.

[Ethio Telecom says its Gola Sefer data centre, launched in May 2021, is Tier 3, on its own word](<https://furtherafrica.com/2022/05/24/ethio-telecom-to-lease-data-center-to-5-private-institutions/>). [RedFox Solutions launched its RFETH-MDC01 modular data centre at the ICT Park in Addis Ababa on 19 September 2022](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_38441>). [In October 2025 Birr Metrics reported state-owned Ethio Telecom's Telecloud at 192 racks and 8,064 servers, serving government and business](<https://birrmetrics.com/us-based-cisco-eyes-ethiopia-market-warns-cloud-rules-limit-access/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

No stage is set. In the last twelve months, Gabon Info said in January 2026 that [the state's public finance system runs from the Treasury data centre](<https://gabon-info.com/2026/01/15/le-gabon-reprend-la-main-sur-sa-souverainete-financiere-et-numerique/>). No source has been found that says a data centre for hire in the country is nationally owned. None dated in the last three years says there is none. Preparing would need a data centre owned by the state, a state enterprise or a company owned in the country to rent space, power or computing to others.

In 2016 [the government opened Ghana's National Data Centre](<https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/ghana-government-opens-data-center-to-private-business/>), built by NITA with Alcatel and Huawei, and it rents colocation space to private firms. In August 2024 NITA said [its certified Tier 3 data centre serves all public institutions and private businesses](<https://techfocus24.com/nita-gets-three-iso-certifications-at-a-go/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. A 2023 bidding document calls [NITA's data centres in Accra and Kumasi the hubs of the government's IT](<https://moc.gov.gh/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Final-Bidding_Document_for_Data_Center_Upgrade.pdf>). No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

[Guineenews reports on the 4 September 2025 launch of the national Data Center](<https://guineenews.org/2025/09/04/guinee-le-ministre-djiba-diakite-procede-au-double-lancement-du-point-gn-et-le-data-center-national-tier-lll/>). COREX's deputy director-general said it is certified Tier 3 Design by Uptime Institute, with Tier 3 construction certification still to come. The telecommunications minister said Guinea's strategic data now stays in Guinea under state control. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

No stage is set. As at 30 September 2026, no source has been found that says a data centre for hire in the country is nationally owned. None dated in the last three years says there is none. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says no data centre for hire in the country is nationally owned.

As at 30 September 2026, [Sipopo Datacenter (GITGE (Gestor de Infraestructuras de Telecomunicaciones de Guinea Ecuatorial)), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service](<https://gitge.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/PRESENTACION-6.pdf>). No source has been found that states who owns the data centre. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one nationally owned data centre for hire to be Tier III or above.

As at 30 September 2026, a Treasury addendum says [the Konza National Data Centre has Uptime Institute Tier III Design and Construction certification](<https://pppkenya.go.ke/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Updated-ADDENDUM-III-TRANSACTION-ADVISORY-SERVICES-FOR-THE-KONZA-CLOUD-EXPANSION-AND-SAMRT-CITY-FACILITIES.pdf>). [Through the Konza Cloud Platform the centre hosts 145 of Kenya's 451 government institutions](<https://pppkenya.go.ke/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Updated-ADDENDUM-III-TRANSACTION-ADVISORY-SERVICES-FOR-THE-KONZA-CLOUD-EXPANSION-AND-SAMRT-CITY-FACILITIES.pdf>). [Safaricom's Thika Data Center, which sells colocation, holds Uptime Institute Tier III design certification](<https://capitalfm.africa/safaricom-thika-data-centre-gets-design-certification-from-us-it-firm/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. In July 2025 [the Konza authority opened a call for partners for the centre](<https://konza.go.ke/konza-cloud-partners/>).

As at 30 September 2026, [Liberia's National Data Governance Policy says the National Data Center is located at the state-owned national operator LTC-Mobile](<https://mopt.gov.lr/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/2026-Liberia-Data-Governance-Policy-REVISED-CIPESA-1.pdf>). The ministry of posts and telecommunications spearheaded it for government and private sector use, and it is being upgraded. The policy does not say who owns the centre. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one nationally owned data centre for hire to be Tier III or above.

In August 2024 Al Sabaah said [the data centres of the Libyan International Telecommunications Company had Uptime Institute Tier III certification](<https://alsabaah.ly/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA/>). [The TransSahara Tripoli Data Center, a joint venture of Trans Sahara ICT and Tatweer, sells colocation](<https://libyaherald.com/2019/11/libyas-trans-sahara-and-moroccos-data-protect-sign-agreement-to-establish-first-data-security-operations-centre-in-libya/>), and its operator says it is Tier III or above. In 2024 [Libyan Spider opened a data centre in Tripoli](<https://libyanspider.com/libyan-spider-opens-new-data-center-in-tripoli-to-enhance-security-and-availability/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The certified centres are not said to rent space to others. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

No stage is set. As at 30 September 2026, no source has been found that says a data centre for hire in the country is nationally owned. None dated in the last three years says there is none. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says no data centre for hire in the country is nationally owned.

In 2021 the Benguerir Data Center, built by OCP Group with UM6P, [opened with a Tier IV design rating and 5 MW of IT load](<https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/university-morocco-africa-supercomputer-toubkal/>). Orange Maroc [says its Casablanca data centre meets Tier III design and facility standards](<https://telquel.ma/2025/02/14/cloud-souverain-orange-maroc-sallie-a-amazon-web-services_1918035>). No certifier is named. No change in either rating has been found in the last twelve months. In June 2026 Le Brief reported that the social support agency's 2025 annual report says [the information systems for direct social aid are hosted in the finance ministry's data centre](<https://www.lebrief.ma/soutien-social-un-an-apres-impact-de-lanss-100155241/>).

As at 30 September 2026, [STELLARIX offers colocation (1U to full 42U racks, carrier-neutral, Smart Hands) from two data centres in Antananarivo, Galaxy Andraharo and Analakely, advertised at 99.982% availability](<https://www.stellar-ix.com/solutions/colocation/housing/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Nothing has been found that says the government hosts its own data in a national data centre. Establishing would need one nationally owned data centre for hire to be Tier III or above.

ITWeb Africa reported on 2 February 2026 that [the Malian government describes the National Data Centre in Bamako as a Tier III facility](<https://itweb.africa/article/mali-unveils-modern-tier-iii-data-centre/>). It is the operator's own statement, and no certification is named. In the last twelve months, [Mali's communication and digital ministry inaugurated the Tier III National Data Centre](<https://itweb.africa/article/mali-unveils-modern-tier-iii-data-centre/>) in the weekend before that report. The government says it will provide secure hosting for the state's strategic data. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more such centres at Tier III or above.

No stage is set. As at 30 September 2026, no source has been found that says a data centre for hire in the country is nationally owned. None dated in the last three years says there is none. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says no data centre for hire in the country is nationally owned.

[The US Country Commercial Guide says the government inaugurated a national data centre in Nouakchott in May 2025, EIB-backed](<https://www.trade.gov/country-commercial-guides/mauritania-digital-economy>). [AMI states the Nouakchott Data Centre, in service from its 2025-05-08 inauguration, holds a Level 3 (Tier III) certification](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/270548>). The guide does not say it rents to outside customers. In the last twelve months, in July 2026, [the minister said all government servers had been moved into the data centre the ministry created](<https://www.ami.mr/archives/263232>). No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

As at 30 September 2026, [Mauritius Telecom Rose Belle Data Centre (Mauritius Telecom Ltd) is a colocation, carrier-neutral facility in service](<https://www.mauritiustimes.com/mt/ai-will-not-become-an-economic-pillar-because-we-declare-it/>). [The article names two operating Mauritian data centres as Tier III or IV](<https://www.telecomreviewafrica.com/articles/features/12397-sublime-seas-to-storage-sphere-mauritius-expands-hyperscale-data-hub/>), Harel Mallac Technologies and Bhumishq, and names no certifier. No change in their ratings has been found in the last twelve months. [L'Express reports that Mauritius Telecom's Rose-Belle data centre hosts government projects](<https://lexpress.mu/node/552966>), seen on a minister's visit on 29 December 2025.

As at 30 September 2026, [TNM states it acquired OpenConnect Limited's Tier 3 data centre at Kanengo, Lilongwe, for K12 billion](<https://www.itweb.africa/article/tnm-expands-malawi-data-infrastructure/mYZRXM9gbA6vOgA8>). The tier is stated by the company, with no certification named. [The Government of Malawi's Department of e-Government runs the National Data Centre in Lilongwe](<https://api.pppc.mw/api/download/722>), which hosts systems of ministries, departments and agencies. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

[The Villager reports on 14 August 2026 that Paratus Namibia's Armada data centre in Windhoek already exists](<https://www.thevillager.com.na/national/2026/pressure-mounting-for-namibia-to-build-own-digital-infrastructure/>). It provides local data centre and hosting services, while the government's national data centre is only planned. [Paratus states the carrier-neutral Armada Data Center in Windhoek is Tier-III by design](<https://paratus.africa/docs/Paratus-Annual-Report-2025-online.pdf>), an operator statement with no Uptime Institute certification named. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

[The Galaxy Backbone data centre in the National Shared Services Centre, Abuja, was commissioned on 20 December 2022](<https://www.thecable.ng/a-data-center-to-drive-the-digital-economy/>). It serves government as well as corporate customers. [Galaxy Backbone, a government-owned company, operates an Uptime Institute Certified Tier III data centre in Abuja](<https://techcabal.com/2026/07/07/cbns-local-data-order-puts-nigerias-data-centres-to-test/>). [21st Century Technologies' Lagos data centre is Tier IV certified](<https://techeconomy.ng/shaping-the-future-of-data-infrastructure-21st-century-technologies-tier-iv-data-centre>). No Uptime Institute certificate is named for it. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [Rest of World describes Galaxy Backbone as a privately held company established by the Nigerian government](<https://restofworld.org/2025/aws-google-cloud-nigeria-alternatives/>). It gives no further ownership detail.

As at 30 September 2026, [TransAfrica Communications (TrAC), a Rwanda-based ISP, is stated to offer data centre collocation services to customers (no facility named, no tier given)](<https://aka-partners.com/insight-and-news/>). [The ministry's ICT Sector Strategic Plan lists, among the initiatives that improved local hosting, the introduction of the TransAfrica Communications (TrAC) data center in Rwanda](<https://www.minict.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/minict_user_upload/Documents/Strategies/ICT__SSP_2024-2029_.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says a nationally owned data centre for hire is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one nationally owned data centre for hire to be Tier III or above.

As at 30 September 2026, [Sudatel states on its operator page that the Sudatel Data Center is a Tier IV data centre](<https://sudani.sd/en/sdc/>). It names no certification body. [Sudani's deputy director general says the company lost its Tier-4 data centre](<https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-01-07/Port-Sudan-emerges-as-Sudan-s-digital-lifeline-amid-conflict-1JJT8b4Ofeg/p.html>), which hosted state government and institutions. [He also says the company restored its core data centre](<https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-01-07/Port-Sudan-emerges-as-Sudan-s-digital-lifeline-amid-conflict-1JJT8b4Ofeg/p.html>). The source gives no date for either, so no change has been found in the last twelve months. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Operating would need two or more such centres at Tier III or above.

[ADIE says the Diamniadio national data centre is the state's first Tier 3 data centre](<https://www.adie.sn/actualites/le-datacenter-de-diamniadio-lieu-d%E2%80%99impulsion-de-la-transformation-digitale-du-s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal>), which opened on 22 June 2021. [Sonatel says its Rufisque data centre holds Uptime Institute Tier III design certification](<https://sonatel.sn/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/Sonatel-Groups-2020-annual-report.pdf>), and it gained a constructed-facility certificate in December 2019. No change has been found in the last twelve months. MFWA says [state agencies have been moving their data to the Diamniadio data centre since November 2023](<https://mfwa.org/impact-stories/senegal-state-agencies-comply-with-policy-on-public-data-management-after-mfwa-fellows-report/>). By January 2024 the health ministry had reportedly moved over 80% of its data.

As at 17 October 2026, [the Ministry of Finance's DFMST page says it operates a Tier III data centre providing co-location services for institutions in the financial sector](<https://mof.gov.sl/dfmst/>). The page gives no date for the centre. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found. Nothing has been found that says the government hosts its own data in a national data centre. Operating would need two or more nationally owned data centres for hire to be Tier III or above.

As at 17 October 2026, [Dalkom Somalia says it offers colocation hosting to business customers from its own data centre in Mogadishu](<https://www.dalkomsomalia.com/managed-national.php?id=187>). [Dalkom Somalia says it is privately owned and funded by Somali individuals and investment companies](<https://www.dalkomsomalia.com/managed-national.php?id=187>).
